method: Two built-in image_gen calls; true transparent_background=true for skill CG. Output aliases are hard links to generated originals to avoid duplicate disk usage. No original image or approved avatar changed.

entries.visual_qa: Reviewed generated 1536x1024 image. Distinct seated sanctuary deity, nested temple courtyards, differently dressed later-imperial ceremonial figures and ordinary worshippers; human ritual dominates lower scene. Broad incense light ribbons, no scattered sparkle noise. Cross-era symbolic montage, not a claim all emperors personally worshipped Guan Yu.

Reviewed generated output and a neutral-gray composite. True transparent regions, no baked checkerboard or rectangular backdrop. One head and two arms; airborne twisted knee-up lunge, two-hand overhead seal, tall gold-jade crown and sun halo, three broad curved jade-gold shield panels. No weapon or generic standing palm-out pose. Core body and feet fit; outer robe/ribbon tips graze canvas margins.
entries.alpha_qa: Native generated alpha preserved without masking or opacity changes. Maximum alpha 254 is native to output; corners are all 0.

not_implemented: Static PNG assets only; no runtime animation, balance changes, main card edits, or avatar edits.
historical_framing: A symbolic cross-era montage of later-imperial worship; no Qin ruler, and no assertion that every ruler or all post-Han emperors personally worshipped Guan Yu.
